scripts.test:modal: python -m unittest discover -s infra/modal -p test_*.py && python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_modal_*.py && vitest run scripts/register-serving-model.test.ts scripts/check-inference.test.ts
scripts.test: npm test -w @enclave/core && npm test -w @enclave/api && npm test -w @enclave/worker && npm test -w @enclave/agent-sdk
scripts.up: docker compose up -d postgres redis anvil
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @enclave/agent-sdk
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:coverage: npm test -w @enclave/core -- --coverage && npm test -w @enclave/worker -- --coverage && npm test -w @enclave/agent-sdk -- --coverage && tsx scripts/test-integration.ts --coverage
